A four-[[Limb|armed]] '''alien''' was present in a [[Unidentified bustling city|city]] on a [[Unidentified world (Latts Razzi)|world]]<ref name="Friends" /> at some point after [[19 BBY]].<ref name="FriendsDate" /> The [[Unidentified four-armed crested species|alien]] was attacked and [[Death|killed]] by the [[bounty hunter]]s [[Latts Razzi]] and [[C-21 Highsinger]], who were assisted by the former [[Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="Friends" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The alien appeared in "[[Friends]]," the second episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'' which premiered on [[May 4]], [[2025]], on [[Disney+]],<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}}</ref> with a pre-release [[May 2|two days earlier]] in the video game ''[[Fortnite]]''.<ref name="Fortnite">{{Fortnite|url=news/get-a-new-stormtrooper-in-fortnite-and-watch-two-episodes-of-star-wars-tales-of-the-underworld|text=Get a New Stormtrooper in Fortnite & Watch Two Episodes of Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld!}}</ref>
